product.name: Catálogo

envVarsSchema.label: Contraseña de la base de datos (sa)

product.composeTemplate:
services:
  flxcatalog-frontend:
    image: localhost:5000/flxcatalog-frontend:1.0.5-beta.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: Development
      BackendEndpoint: http://flxcatalog-backend:8080/api/backend/
    volumes:
      - flxcatalog-front-conf:/app/conf
      - flxcatalog-front-custom:/app/custom
    networks:
      - proxy
      - default
    depends_on:
      - flxcatalog-backend
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.docker.network=proxy
      - traefik.http.routers.${APP_SUBDOMAIN}.rule=Host(`${APP_SUBDOMAIN}.${BASE_DOMAIN}`)
      - traefik.http.services.${APP_SUBDOMAIN}.loadbalancer.server.port=8080
  flxcatalog-backend:
    image: localhost:5000/flxcatalog-backend:1.0.5-beta.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: Development
      MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD: ${SQL_PASSWORD}
      FrontendEndpoint: http://flxcatalog-frontend:8080
      ConnectionStrings__ConfConnectionString: Server=flxcatalog-db;Integrated Security=false;Initial Catalog=flxCatalog_IC;User ID=sa;Password=${SQL_PASSWORD};Encrypt=False;TrustServerCertificate=True
      ConnectionStrings__DataConnectionString: Server=flxcatalog-db;Integrated Security=false;Initial Catalog=flxCatalog_I;User ID=sa;Password=${SQL_PASSWORD};Encrypt=False;TrustServerCertificate=True
      DatabaseNuget__PackageId: flxCatalog.Conf.Database
      DatabaseNuget__NugetUrl: http://localhost:5100/v3/index.json
      DatabaseNuget__PreReleaseVersions: "true"
    volumes:
      - flxcatalog-back-conf:/app/conf
      - flxcatalog-back-custom:/app/custom
    depends_on:
      flxcatalog-db:
        condition: service_healthy
  flxcatalog-db:
    image: localhost:5000/flxcatalog-db:1.0.5-beta.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      ACCEPT_EULA: Y
      MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD: ${SQL_PASSWORD}
      MSSQL_PID: Express
    volumes:
      - flxcatalog-db-data:/var/opt/mssql/data/
      - flxcatalog-db-log:/var/opt/mssql/log/
      - flxcatalog-db-secrets:/var/opt/mssql/secrets/
volumes:
  flxcatalog-front-conf:
  flxcatalog-front-custom:
  flxcatalog-back-conf:
  flxcatalog-back-custom:
  flxcatalog-db-data:
  flxcatalog-db-log:
  flxcatalog-db-secrets:
networks:
  proxy:
    external: true
